Two separate incidents report bodies found in fields

Two separate incidents in Rajasthan have led to the discovery of bodies in agricultural fields. In Sujangarh, a missing elderly man's body was found in a farm pond after three days. In a separate case, the skeletal remains of a mute and deaf teenager, who had been missing for several days, were found in a sugarcane field, with suspicions of murder.
